description: Aura blends the timeless allure of a traditional loop pile with a refreshing, contemporary twist. Immerse yourself in its soothing and grounding colour palette that elevates both your space and your well-being. Crafted from 100% recycled polyester with a sustainable felt backing, Aura not only beautifies your home but leaves a smaller footprint on the earth.
Soft and dense with a fine cut pile structure, Bliss is a sensuous treat made from 100% recycled yarn. Immerse yourself in its rich, botanical tones of nature and enjoy to relax and feel good.

Dive into a world of untamed luxury and eco-conscious comfort with Bloom. This shaggy carpet’s wild and curly texture adds a touch of natural beauty to your space, while the subdued and nature-infused colour palette lets your interior flourish. Plus, it’s made from 100% recycled polyester.

Elevate your space to new levels of comfort with Comfy Vibe. Experience the gratifying softness of this refined cut pile in an elegant, neutral colour palette that complements any decor, filling your room with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

Made from 100% recycled yarn, Feliz is a low maintenance product that’s kind to the planet. It’s ideal for game rooms, play areas or spaces where relaxing and leisure come first. Indulge in its natural texture and complete downtime spaces with grounded earth tones.

Transform your living space into a haven of opulence with Gentle Nuance. The elegant colour palette and lush texture bring a touch of sophistication and tactile warmth to your home, creating an inviting atmosphere for relaxation and indulgence.

Where simplicity meets sophistication.

Designed for those who appreciate the elegance of minimalism, Kanso provides a versatile foundation for crafting a serene space. Its textured design introduces a tactile dimension to your space, while the natural colours, drawn from the calming beauty of nature, infuse warmth and authenticity. Let the essence of Japanese design metamorphose your surroundings into a haven of refined comfort.

Marlene is the epitome of textured sophistication. It taps into the trend for luxury at home with the powerful and evocative sensation of soft velvet underfoot that promises to make any setting more intimate. It’s perfect as a final touch to a minimalistic room or a place that you want to relax in, as you would in a luxurious winter cocoon.
